categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 研究集中在奖励与采样设计、推理能力挖掘、模型内部表示的可控编辑与安全评测，以及边缘推理等落地场景。

articles.title: Density-Aware Reward Scaling: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reward-Proportional Sampling
articles.zh: 密度感知的奖励缩放：面向奖励比例采样的强化学习框架
articles.summary: 如果你在调 RL 采样的奖励权重，这篇提醒你奖励密度分布不均会让"按比例采样"直接失衡，得先看分布再定缩放。
articles.author: Ria Shekhawat, Abhijeet Sinha 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning objectives that maximize expected return can concentrate probability mass on a small subset of high-reward outcomes, limiting diversity when multiple distinct solutions are desirable. We introduce Density-Aware Reward Scaling (DARS), a simple reward-processing mechanism that promotes reward-proportional sampling in continuous outcome spaces while retaining standard policy-gradient training. DARS estimates the local density of outcomes within each on-policy rollout group and inversely scales rewards by this density. The method requires no learned density model, auxiliary objective, critic, or modification to the underlying policy-gradient objective. In a controlled multimodal navigation task, DARS-GRPO avoids the single-mode collapse exhibited by GRPO and closely recovers the target mode allocation. Applied to text-to-image prompt adaptation, DARS-GRPO consistently improves image and prompt diversity across datasets, Policy LMs, and reward settings while maintaining good semantic alignment. These results show that density-aware reward scaling provides a lightweight way to improve coverage of diverse high-reward outcomes within existing reinforcement-learning pipelines.
articles.bodyZh: 强化学习目标如果一味追求期望回报最大化，就容易把概率质量（probability mass）集中到一小部分高回报结果上；当我们想要多个不同方案时，这就会限制多样性。我们提出一种叫密度感知奖励缩放（Density-Aware Reward Scaling, DARS）的简单奖励处理机制：它在连续结果空间（continuous outcome spaces）里推动按奖励比例采样（reward-proportional sampling），同时保留标准的策略梯度训练（policy-gradient training）。DARS 会在每一组同策略采样（on-policy rollout）结果里估计局部密度（local density），再按这个密度对奖励做反向缩放。这个方法不需要额外学习密度模型，不需要辅助目标（auxiliary objective），不需要评论家（critic），也不用改动底层的策略梯度目标（policy-gradient objective）。在一个可控的多模态导航任务（multimodal navigation task）里，DARS-GRPO 避免了 GRPO 出现的单一模式坍缩（single-mode collapse），并且能比较接近地恢复目标模式分配（target mode allocation）。把它用到文生图提示词适配（text-to-image prompt adaptation）上时，DARS-GRPO 在不同数据集、策略语言模型（Policy LMs）和奖励设置下，都能稳定提升图像和提示词的多样性，同时保持不错的语义对齐（semantic alignment）。这些结果表明，密度感知的奖励缩放是一种轻量级办法，能在现有强化学习流程里提升对多种高回报结果的覆盖。

articles.title: ReSI-Math: Exploring Recoverable Capability Frontiers for Efficient Reasoning Improvement
articles.zh: ReSI-Math：探索可恢复能力边界以高效提升推理能力
articles.summary: 如果你在刷数学推理 benchmark，这篇的思路是先揪出模型"本来会、只是没使出来"的题再针对性训练，比无脑堆数据省算力。
articles.author: Yao Cui, Zhen Yang 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, a fundamental question remains: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability? In this work, we reveal that direct failure does not necessarily imply inability. Some reasoning failures can be recovered by exploring the model's own trajectories, exposing a recoverable capability frontier: a policy-dependent region where solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through trajectory-level search. Based on this observation, we introduce ReSI-Math, a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and converts recovered capabilities into data-efficient RLVR supervision. ReSI-Math uses Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search to identify recoverable failures under a fixed policy and adaptively selects frontier problems for sequential RLVR as the policy evolves. On Qwen3-VL-8B, correct-incorrect trajectory crossover produces 272 verifier-confirmed correct offspring from 621 attempts (43.8%). After three sequential one-shot RLVR stages, the MATH500 and WE-MATH average improves from 78.71 to 80.16. Under matched single-problem RLVR, random selection reaches only 53.31 versus 54.16 for frontier-guided Q1.
articles.bodyZh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已经成为提升大语言模型数学推理能力的有效方法。但有个根本问题一直没解决：模型做不出一道题，是真的不会，还是只是没答对？这项研究揭开了一个关键发现——直接答错不等于真不会。有些推理失败其实是可以救回来的，只要你愿意去探索模型自己的答题轨迹。这就暴露出了一个“可恢复的能力边界”：这是一个跟策略有关的区域，在这里直接解码不一定能稳定生成正确答案，但通过轨迹级别的搜索却能捞出来。基于这个观察，我们提出了ReSI-Math框架，专门去探索这些可恢复的能力边界，把捞回来的能力转化成数据高效的RLVR监督信号。ReSI-Math用的是自我判断引导的进化搜索（Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search），在固定策略下找出那些可恢复的失败案例，并且随着策略的进化，自适应地挑选边界问题来做序贯RLVR训练。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，正确轨迹和错误轨迹交叉后，621次尝试中验证器确认了272个正确的子代，成功率达到43.8%。经过三个序贯的单题RLVR阶段，MATH500和WE-MATH的平均分从78.71提升到了80.16。而在匹配的单题RLVR设置下，随机选择只能达到53.31，而边界引导的Q1则达到了54.16。

articles.title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
articles.zh: Kierston 与 KierstonBench：Allentown 市模拟环境及语言模型在犯罪侦查与监控任务上的评测
articles.summary: 如果你关心 LLM 进执法和监控场景的边界，这个 benchmark 把"模型在侦查任务里到底会怎么判断"摆上台面，也顺手暴露了误判和隐私风险。
articles.author: Andrew Semenov, Svyatoslav Dorofeev
articles.body: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. Their capability and accuracy in this work cannot currently be measured. Real deployments lack the ground truth needed to score a model's conclusions, and no benchmark evaluates these capabilities in a simulated environment. We present Kierston, a city-scale simulation engine, and KierstonBench, a benchmark that tests these capabilities against known simulated events. Kierston models approximately 125,000 residents of Allentown, Pennsylvania, generating their daily activities and the telecommunications, financial, administrative and license-plate records that surveillance and investigative systems collect about them. These records derive from a common behavioral timeline and are distributed across sources representing separate providers. Models investigate through a restricted records interface, linking observations across sources without access to the underlying simulation. The benchmark comprises 32 task families covering record linkage, routine reconstruction, incident investigation and assessment of deceptive accounts. In an evaluation of sixteen language models, most could not perform records investigation and submitted identifications the records did not support. A small number of frontier models solved most of the tasks and abstained when evidence was insufficient. In some cases these models still fell for common deceptions and assumptions, and none replaced an investigator.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（large language models）有望在刑事调查和大规模监控中用来收集和分析记录。但它们干这活儿的能力和准确率，目前还没法衡量。真实部署里缺少能用来给模型结论打分的“标准答案”（ground truth），也没有哪个基准测试（benchmark）能在模拟环境里评估这些能力。我们推出Kierston——一个城市规模的模拟引擎（simulation engine），以及KierstonBench——一个基准测试，用已知的模拟事件来检验这些能力。Kierston模拟了宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦大约12.5万名居民，生成他们的日常活动，以及监控和调查系统会收集到的电信、金融、行政和车牌记录。这些记录来自同一条行为时间线，分散在代表不同提供方的数据源里。模型通过受限记录接口（restricted records interface）来调查，在接触不到底层模拟的情况下，跨数据源把观察结果关联起来。这个基准测试包含32个任务族，覆盖记录关联（record linkage）、日常轨迹重建（routine reconstruction）、事件调查（incident investigation）和对欺骗性账户（deceptive accounts）的评估。在对16个语言模型的评估中，大多数模型做不了记录调查，提交的指认结果记录根本不支持。少数前沿模型（frontier models）解决了大部分任务，证据不足时也会不作判断。但在有些情况下，这些模型仍会掉进常见骗局、想当然，而且没有一个能替代调查员。

articles.title: Reducing Logprob Without Causal Verification: Diagnosing SAE-Based PII Suppression in LLMs
articles.zh: 降低 Logprob 却无因果验证：诊断基于 SAE 的 LLM 个人信息抑制
articles.summary: 如果你用 SAE 做敏感信息擦除，这篇告诉你 logprob 掉下去不等于信息真被删了，别把指标下降当因果证据。
articles.author: Chaerin Lee, Wonho Lee 等
articles.body: SAE-based feature-level interventions to suppress PII leakage in LLMs are primarily evaluated by log-probability reduction. We show that this criterion cannot distinguish feature specific suppression from a magnitude artifact: a direction-agnostic effect of sufficiently large activation perturbations. Across 36 (model, layer, PII type) cases, we compare selected SAE feature interventions with coherencematched random direction controls using logprob and rank-aware metrics. While 17 cases (47%) appear successful under logprob-only evaluation, only 1 case (2.8%) passes our multimetric framework. The rest reveal two failure modes: random directions outperform selected features, and feature selection collapse across PII types. These results indicate that existing evaluations cannot verify whether interventions target causal pathways of PII leakage. A 9,000 run causal mediation feasibility study corroborates this: the verifier separates candidates reliably, but correlation-selected candidates rarely pass it. We therefore propose a new research mission for NLP: causally grounded PII suppression through circuit-level localization and causal mediation analysis.
articles.bodyZh: 用 SAE（稀疏自编码器）做特征层面的干预，来压住 LLMs（大语言模型）里的 PII（个人身份信息）泄露，目前主要看对数概率降了多少。但我们发现，这个标准分不清“真的压住了特定特征”和“只是幅度够大造成的假象”：只要激活扰动足够大，不管方向对不对，都可能出现类似效果。我们覆盖了 36 个（模型、层、PII 类型）组合，把选中的 SAE 特征干预，和经过连贯性匹配的随机方向对照组，用对数概率指标和排序感知指标一起比较。结果，单看对数概率时有 17 个案例（47%）像是成功了，但放到我们的多指标框架里，只有 1 个案例（2.8%）过关。其余案例暴露出两种翻车方式：一是随机方向反而比选中的特征效果更好；二是特征选择在不同 PII 类型之间直接崩掉。这说明，现有评估没法验证干预到底有没有打中 PII 泄露的因果通路。一个 9,000 次运行的因果中介可行性研究也印证了这一点：验证器能可靠地把候选分开，但按相关性选出来的候选很少能过。因此，我们给 NLP（自然语言处理）提了个新的研究任务：通过电路级定位和因果中介分析，做有因果依据的 PII 抑制。

articles.title: Replica-Aware Split Inference for Edge IoT Systems
articles.zh: 面向边缘 IoT 系统的副本感知拆分推理
articles.summary: 如果你在做端侧拆分推理部署，这篇提醒副本一致性会实打实拖慢流水线，调度时不能只算算力和带宽。
articles.author: Zied Jenhani, Nasrin Razmi 等
articles.body: Split Inference (SI) addresses the hardware resource limitations of Internet of Things (IoT) devices by distributing tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) model segments across multiple IoT devices. However, a device failure can interrupt the inference pipeline. This paper proposes a replica-aware recovery approach that deploys replicas of TinyML model segments originally hosted on failed devices onto surviving devices. We formulate the joint selection of replica hosts and communication protocols as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem that minimizes post-reconfiguration inference latency, accounting for computation and transmission latencies, under flash memory and runtime memory constraints. Simulations using MobileNetV2 on heterogeneous IoT networks compare the proposed approach with four baselines. We implement the model in a network of 15 IoT devices with a maximum link-rate reduction of 75%, and show that MILP approach achieves an average modeled end-to-end inference latency that is 6.8% lower than that of Computation Greedy and 18.3% lower than that of Random. Index Terms TinyML, split inference, Internet of Things, fault tolerance, replica placement.
articles.bodyZh: 分割推理（Split Inference, SI）是为了解决物联网（Internet of Things, IoT）设备硬件资源不够用的问题：它把小型机器学习（TinyML）模型拆成一小段一小段，分散放到多台物联网设备上跑。可问题是，只要有一台设备挂了，整条推理流水线就可能断掉。这篇论文提出了一种带副本的恢复办法：原来跑在故障设备上的 TinyML 模型片段，会在还活着的设备上放副本；一旦设备坏了，就把这些副本部署到存活设备上接着跑。作者把“副本放哪台设备”和“用哪种通信协议”这两件事放在一起选，建成了一个混合整数线性规划（mixed-integer linear programming, MILP）问题，目标是在闪存和运行时内存都受限的情况下，让重配置之后的推理延迟尽量小，计算延迟和传输延迟都算进去。仿真部分用 MobileNetV2，在异构物联网网络里把提出方法和四个基线方法做对比。他们还在一个由 15 台物联网设备组成的网络里做了实现，最大把链路速率降低了 75%，结果显示 MILP 方法平均端到端推理延迟（模型算出来的）比 Computation Greedy 低 6.8%，比 Random 低 18.3%。关键词：TinyML、分割推理、物联网、容错、副本放置。

articles.title: TactiNavi: Serving and Revising an LLM Game Coach with Explicit Strategy Conditions
articles.zh: TactiNavi：以显式策略条件服务并修订 LLM 游戏教练
articles.summary: 如果你想让 LLM 当实时教练而不是聊天陪玩，这篇给了个把战术策略显式建模、还能随局势现场修正的路子。
articles.author: Qi Liu, Xiaoyang Yuan 等
articles.body: A deployed LLM coaching agent answers requests whose correct response depends on player state and game version, so advice that is right for one player can be wrong for the next. We describe TactiNavi, the serving system behind the LLM coach of a commercial open-world game, which makes strategy applicability an explicit artifact shared by offline compilation, online execution, failure diagnosis, and release. An offline compiler turns versioned game evidence and expert guidance into strategy packages with explicit prerequisites, the serving plane evaluates those prerequisites as three-valued conditions over structured player state and records decision traces, and a control plane uses the resulting condition-rule dependencies to validate revisions on held-out traffic before release. In a retrospective evaluation of 1,122 logged coaching turns from three deployment periods, condition-bearing packages raise correctness from 57.9% to 82.0% over atomic facts and reduce strategy misapplication under changed player state from 18.1% to 10.4%, while trace-based claim verification reaches 86.4% precision at a median reply latency of 2.07 s. The deployment also showed that most apparent fixes are generation noise, because an unchanged-system rerun recovers 38.4% of failing turns and only one of 15 shipped revision units passes the release checks retrospectively. We distill these results into lessons on treating applicability as a first-class serving object, sizing traces for later diagnosis, and building the null model into the release path.
articles.bodyZh: 一个已经上线的 LLM 教练智能体（coaching agent），回答问题时得看玩家状态（player state）和游戏版本（game version）；对某个玩家正确的建议，换个人可能就不对了。我们介绍 TactiNavi——一款商业开放世界游戏里 LLM 教练背后的服务系统。它把策略适不适用（strategy applicability）做成一个明确的产物，让离线编译（offline compilation）、在线执行（online execution）、故障诊断（failure diagnosis）和发布（release）都共用它。离线编译器（offline compiler）把带版本的游戏证据（game evidence）和专家指导，编成带明确前置条件（prerequisites）的策略包（strategy packages）；服务面（serving plane）把这些前置条件当成针对结构化玩家状态的三值条件（three-valued conditions）来评估，并记录决策轨迹（decision traces）；控制面（control plane）则利用由此得到的条件-规则依赖关系（condition-rule dependencies），在发布前用留出流量（held-out traffic）验证修订。对三个部署周期里 1,122 条记录下来的教练回合（coaching turns）做回顾性评估（retrospective evaluation）：带条件的策略包把正确率从 57.9% 提到 82.0%，比原子事实（atomic facts）高；并把玩家状态变化时的策略误用（strategy misapplication）从 18.1% 降到 10.4%；同时，基于轨迹的主张核验（trace-based claim verification）达到 86.4% 精确率（precision），回复延迟中位数（median reply latency）是 2.07 秒。部署还显示，大多数看起来像修复的东西其实是生成噪声（generation noise）：系统不变重跑一遍，能把 38.4% 的失败回合救回来；而 15 个已发布修订单元里，事后只有 1 个能通过发布检查。我们把这些结果提炼成几条经验：把适用性当成一等服务对象（first-class serving object）；为后续诊断把轨迹记录的量级定合适；把空白对照模型（null model）纳入发布流程。

articles.title: When Should an LLM Steering Edit Depend on the Input?
articles.zh: LLM 激活编辑何时应当依赖输入？
articles.summary: 如果你在用 activation steering 调模型行为，这篇问了个常被跳过的问题——固定方向的编辑到底该不该随输入变化。
articles.author: Rachael Harkness, Konrad Rawlik
articles.body: An activation steering edit should depend on the input exactly when the destination varies \emph{inside} the class a query requests, and that is measurable before any rule is fitted or applied. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) adds one fixed direction to every input, the difference of the class means. Conditioning it on the requested class accounts for the between-class variation in the required displacement and leaves the within-class variation untouched, which no rule that reads only the source state can express. We study the impact of increasing input-dependence in the steering edit, moving from a difference of means to a destination retrieved per query --- the mean of the $k$ stored states nearest the query, inside the requested class --- in which the two baselines are endpoints: at $k$ equal to the class size the retrieved rule \emph{is} the class-conditional difference of means. We measure input-dependent steering on six substitution corpora that vary in whether the edit changes a word or a clause, and on an external benchmark, and find that input-dependent steering outperforms fixed-direction steering when the destination varies within the class. Retrieval wins at every layer of every substitution corpus in two models, and the level of input-dependence needed governs how to apply it: word-level edits are best made in the first tenth of the network from a few neighbours, clause-level edits at any depth from the class mean. Where the class already determines the answer the class mean suffices and retrieval only matches it, though a fixed direction still fails there. Four quantities computed from the states alone identify the regime in which the edit should be applied.
articles.bodyZh: 激活引导编辑（activation steering edit）到底该不该依赖输入，判断标准其实很直接：只有当查询（query）所请求的类别（class）内部，目的地（destination）会发生变化时，它才该依赖输入；而且这一点在任何规则（rule）被拟合或应用之前就能测出来。对比激活加法（Contrastive Activation Addition, CAA）是给每个输入都加上同一个固定方向，也就是各类别均值（class means）之间的差。把它按请求的类别做条件化，能解释所需位移在类别之间的差异，却把类别内部的差异原封不动地留下；而任何只看源状态（source state）的规则，都表达不了这种内部差异。我们研究的是：让引导编辑越来越依赖输入（input-dependence），会带来什么影响——从简单的均值差，一路走到“每次查询都检索一个目的地”，也就是在请求的类别里，取离查询最近的 k 个已存状态的平均值。在这个谱系里，前面两种做法就是两个基线（baselines），正好是两端：当 k 等于类别大小时，检索出来的规则就是按类别条件化的均值差。我们在六个替换语料库（substitution corpora）上测了依赖输入的引导（input-dependent steering），这些语料库的区别在于编辑改变的是一个词还是一个从句；另外还在一个外部基准（external benchmark）上测了。结果发现：当目的地会在类别内部变化时，依赖输入的引导比固定方向引导（fixed-direction steering）表现更好。检索法在两个模型、每个替换语料库的每一层都赢；而需要多大程度的输入依赖，决定了该怎么用它：词级编辑（word-level edits）最好在网络前十分之一、用少数几个近邻来做；从句级编辑（clause-level edits）在任何深度都可以直接用类别均值。要是类别本身已经决定了答案，那类别均值就够了，检索法也只能跟它打平；不过固定方向在这种地方仍然会失败。最后，只靠状态本身算出来的四个量，就能判断这次编辑该应用在哪种情形（regime）里。

articles.title: TAPES: Task-Aligned Joint Predictive Pretraining for Transaction Event Sequences
articles.zh: TAPES：面向交易事件序列的任务对齐联合预测预训练
articles.summary: 如果你在做交易或金融事件序列建模，这篇指出通用预训练目标和下游任务不对齐，联合预测预训练能补上这块。
articles.author: Ruobing Zuo, Weiyu Han 等
articles.body: Transaction event sequences support diverse prediction tasks in online commerce and digital financial services. The same transaction records can yield prediction targets with different semantics, including values, changes, and relations to past events. These targets impose different constraints on history representations, but their predictability alone does not establish the downstream utility of a target set. Moreover, target-wise prediction losses do not explicitly model conditional co-occurrence among targets. To address these challenges, we propose TAPES, a task-aligned joint predictive pretraining framework for transaction sequences. TAPES constructs a finite collection of candidate target sets from admissible field-operator combinations. It selects a target set according to the downstream utility of representations learned through short joint pretraining trials under matched budgets. It then reinitializes the encoder and pretrains it on the selected targets through a joint likelihood parameterized by a shared discrete latent variable, before downstream supervised adaptation. Experiments in a real-world transaction-risk setting and on multiple public financial benchmarks spanning diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that TAPES outperforms representative baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of predictive target selection and joint modeling.
articles.bodyZh: 在线交易和数字金融服务里，交易事件序列（transaction event sequences）能支撑各种各样的预测任务（prediction tasks）。同一批交易记录（transaction records），可以产出语义（semantics）不同的预测目标，比如具体取值、变化情况，以及和历史事件之间的关系。这些目标会对历史表征（history representations）提出不同约束，但光看它们能不能预测，并不能说明这组目标在下游到底有多大用，也就是下游效用（downstream utility）。而且，逐个目标算预测损失（target-wise prediction losses），并没有显式建模目标之间的条件共现（conditional co-occurrence）关系。为了解决这些问题，我们提出 TAPES，一个面向交易序列、任务对齐的联合预测预训练框架（task-aligned joint predictive pretraining framework）。TAPES 会从可接受的字段-算子组合（field-operator combinations）里，构造一组数量有限的候选目标集合（candidate target sets）。然后，它会在同等预算（matched budgets）下做短程联合预训练试验（short joint pretraining trials），根据学到的表征在下游的效用，来挑一个目标集合。接着，它会重新初始化编码器（encoder），在选中的目标上，用由共享离散隐变量（shared discrete latent variable）参数化的联合似然（joint likelihood）做预训练，然后再做下游监督适配（downstream supervised adaptation）。在真实交易风险场景（real-world transaction-risk setting），以及多个公开金融基准（public financial benchmarks，覆盖多种下游任务）上的实验表明，TAPES 比代表性基线（representative baselines）表现更好。消融研究（ablation studies）也进一步验证了预测目标选择（predictive target selection）和联合建模（joint modeling）各自的贡献。
